name: terminal-tab-process-cleaner
description: Kills tracked terminal child processes when a terminal tab is closed.

terminalProcessCleaner.enabled.description: Track terminal child processes and clean them up when a terminal tab is closed.

terminalProcessCleaner.dryRun.description: Log processes that would be killed without sending signals.

terminalProcessCleaner.pollIntervalMs.description: How often to refresh each terminal's descendant process list.

terminalProcessCleaner.gracePeriodMs.description: How long to wait after the first signal before force-killing remaining processes.

terminalProcessCleaner.killSignal.description: The first signal sent to tracked processes when their terminal tab closes.

terminalProcessCleaner.forceKillAfterGra.description: Send SIGKILL to tracked processes that remain after the grace period.

terminalProcessCleaner.excludeProcessNam.description: Executable names that should never be killed, for example ["ssh", "tmux"].

terminalProcessCleaner.excludeCommands.description: Case-insensitive command-line fragments that should never be killed.

terminalProcessCleaner.showNotifications.description: Show a notification after processes are cleaned up.

terminalProcessCleaner.logLevel.description: How much detail to write to the Terminal Process Cleaner output channel.
